_about: Single source of truth for ship, weapon and armour technical data. Embedded into index.html by build.py (src/16_db.js). Colours are "#rrggbb" strings (converted to ints at load for the keys listed in src/16_db.js). Geometry (prims) stays in src/3x_ships_*.js. Source values: scaling (32_scale.js) and the fighter turn/afterburner rules are applied on top at load. Power: ships.<id>.power = {plantMW, capacitorMJ}; src/16_db.js derives energyRegen = plantMW / 3 (balanced 4/4/4 split gives each of the three buses one third) and energyMax = capacitorMJ.

kestrel_2.scaffolding: EXAMPLE ONLY: shows the marks schema (docs/MARKS_SCHEMA.md). Numbers are placeholders inside the +8..12% own-lane band, not balance data.

jumpSpool.note: refit jump coils (the two orange collars); spool time and abort rules belong to the campaign engine

tuning._about: Combat balance constants that used to be hard-coded in src/*. Read through TUNE (src/16_db.js). Edit here; with ?db=data/db.json a reload is enough.
tuning.dmgxNote: [shield, (armour column retired), structure] multiplier per damage type

kestrel.mounts: right boom carries the MD-9 mag (owner 2026-10-22): 3 gun systems - cannon, mag, HE - plus missiles
kestrel.launch: nose of the under-wing pylon missiles (x mirrors per launch)

exeter.mounts: bow prong tips (prims seg ends at [16, 5, -226]) | XL mass driver: emitter in the centre mass, muzzle at the bow face; charge machine in 79_bullfrog.js
exeter.turrets: owner decision 2026-10-22: 2x2 L mass driver turrets (dorsal pair fwd, ventral pair mid) and 4x2 M lasers

toad.launch: front of the ventral torpedo pod cluster

gulper.launch: mouth of the ventral drum (launch bay)

weapons.he: high-explosive shells: direct hit + splash (blastAt) within 8 m; replaced the PL-4 plasma bolter in the realism pass 2026-10-22 (9 dmg/500 rds to hold the ~10 even point: kin hits shields at 0.7x vs the old en 1.25x, and the plasma had no magazine)
weapons.rail: mag/rail class (owner 2026-10-22): projectile + capacitor - ammo AND a small energy draw
weapons.rotary: A-10-style (owner 2026-10-22): 25 rps, 900-rd magazine = 36 s of fire - the magazine IS the weapon
weapons.fmag: Kestrel heavy hitter, mag/rail class (owner 2026-10-22): 30 energy per slug from the 100-pt pool AND a 120-slug magazine - projectile plus capacitor; the ETS WEAPONS channel speeds the recharge
weapons.mdl: mag/rail class: 250-rd magazine ~9 min of fire + a small capacitor draw per slug    // Exeter L turret: rail-family slug, big targets only (fighters inside 900 m)
weapons.mdxl: XL main, Exeter (owner decision 2026-10-22): same charge/lock/cool machine as the FROGG spine (79_bullfrog.js), but a kinetic slug from the rail family; mount carries store:'spine' so fireGuns skips it | 100 slugs (owner 2026-10-22: the magazine scales with the weapon, the XL's is 100)
weapons.laser: lasers: instant hit, but they must FOCUS: no damage until the beam has stayed on one ship for `acq` sim-seconds, then per-pulse damage climbs from 0.25x to `peak`x over `ramp`. A steady beam deposits far more per hit, which is what gets through hard-armour size thresholds; armour/shield type then decides the rest. | `bw` = drawn beam width in metres (61_beams.js; default derived from dmg and range, max 20). Losing the target for > `gap` resets it. (sim seconds; real time = /SIM_SPEED 0.375). Turret lasers on corvettes and up.
weapons.laserM: Exeter M turret: the LS-2's heavier sister
weapons.pd: Phalanx-style drum ~110 s; flak 6: proximity-burst vs missiles (owner P0 2026-10-22: direct hits on a 1.6 m box intercepted nothing)
weapons.flaser: ---- FROGG ---- (realism pass 2026-10-22: biological-acid weapons became masers (en, the green bolts) and autocannon/penetrator kinetics; ids are stable, display names are what the player sees) | fighter pulse bank: ~12-pulse burst from the capacitor, then limited by recharge
weapons.lance: continuous large maser: needs a big power pool (def.energyMax)
weapons.rodg: mag/rail class: heavy rods, small magazine + capacitor draw (owner rule)    // AP rod: replaced the LASH CANNON as the Gulper's main; the penetrator-rod variant of the FROGG kinetic family
weapons.ir: ---- missiles ----  seeker: ir (flares fool it) / rf (chaff fools it)
weapons.nuke: owner 2026-10-22: standard load is a realistic battlefield yield (B61-style sub-kiloton tactical setting); dial via `?nukeKt=` 0.1 (minimum) to 10 kT; strategic 100 kT-10 MT is lore-only (docs/NUKES.md)
weapons.spine: XL main (realism pass 2026-10-22: the FROGG energy family is masers; ids are stable, names are player-facing): mount has store:'spine' so fireGuns skips it; charge then an instant 12 m wide ray, see spineStep / spineFire
weapons.thorn: PD drum + proximity-burst flak, radius 5 vs the PD-30's 6 (humans keep the better PD)
